summary_en: Sumitomo raised its full-year dividend forecast for fiscal 2027 (ending March 2027) by 4 yen per share to 44 yen, including an interim dividend of 22 yen announced on November 2, 2026. The increase follows an upward revision of consolidated net income guidance to 67.0 billion yen from 63.0 billion yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Consolidated Earnings Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027, Interim Dividend Payment, and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Sumitomo Corporation announced on November 2, 2026, an upward revision of its consolidated earnings forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. Net income attributable to the parent company was revised to 67.0 billion yen from the previously forecasted 63.0 billion yen, reflecting strong performance in the interim period and stable business conditions expected in the second half.

In line with this earnings upgrade, the company increased its full-year dividend forecast by 4 yen per share to 44 yen, comprising an interim dividend of 22 yen (previously forecast at 20 yen) and a final dividend of 22 yen. The interim dividend of 22 yen per share was approved at the November 2 board meeting with a record date of September 30, 2026, and an effective date of December 1, 2026. Total interim dividend payout reached approximately 103.96 billion yen.

The company stated that dividend increases are implemented under its progressive dividend policy (whereby annual per-share dividends are maintained or increased relative to the prior year), with the objective of enhancing dividend stability and increasing dividends in line with earnings growth. This aligns with the shareholder return policy announced under the Medium-Term Management Plan 2026, which targets a total return ratio of 40 percent or higher through dividends and flexible opportunistic share buybacks.
